title: What Would You Do in League of Legends’ High-Stakes Moments?
description: Answer 12 questions to discover your in-game decision-making style in League of Legends!

questions.text: Your team is losing badly and a teammate starts blaming others in chat. You...

options.text: Private message the upset teammate to calm them down and suggest a small play to get back in the game
Point out specific mistakes objectively and outline a clear plan for the rest of the match
Type out encouraging lines, rallying the team to focus on the next objective
Ignore the chat entirely, focusing only on farming and catching solo kills to turn the tide

questions.text: You’re playing a support and your ADC is begging for you to roam to mid. You...

options.text: Alternate between watching your ADC and wandering the river to spot enemy movements
Stay with your ADC, ensuring they have vision and protection while they farm
Stick to your pre-planned warding route first, then check mid for gank opportunities
Roam to mid immediately, looking for a chance to set up a kill that could swing the map

questions.text: An enemy jungler ambushes you in the jungle. You...

options.text: Fake an escape to trick the enemy, then turn around to land a surprise stun
Call for your jungler to counter-gank immediately while you fight back to buy time
Disengage quickly and retreat to your turret without drawing unnecessary attention
Use your escape ability right away and head to the nearest brush with vision

questions.text: It’s late game, and your team can’t decide whether to Baron or take enemy inhibitors. You...

options.text: Propose a timer: take Baron in 30 seconds if no enemies show up, else go for inhibitors
Suggest splitting up—send two to push inhibitors while the rest take Baron
Vote for inhibitors, since it will make your team feel more secure about pushing the base
Insist on Baron, as the stat buff is the most logical way to end the game quickly

questions.text: You’re trying a new champion you’ve never played before. You...

options.text: Ask your teammates for tips on how to play the champion effectively
Watch a quick guide on basic combos and stick to them strictly during the game
Figure out the champion’s mechanics by testing them in lane without asking for help
Experiment with ability sequences on the fly to find what works best for your playstyle

questions.text: Your team is about to take the enemy Nexus, but a teammate is still dead and will respawn in 10 seconds. You...

options.text: Attack the Nexus right away—every second counts, and the risk is worth the reward
Wait for your teammate to respawn so you can push together safely
Wait, since leaving your teammate out might make them feel excluded from the win
Start attacking the Nexus immediately, hoping to finish it before enemies return

questions.text: You’re playing mid lane and the enemy is constantly poking you out of lane. You...

options.text: Ping your jungler repeatedly to come gank and relieve the pressure
Plan a surprise all-in once you hit level 6, using your ultimate to turn the tables
Play passively under turret, farming minions with range abilities until you level up
Buy a Doran’s Shield to reduce incoming damage and stay in lane longer

questions.text: Your teammate picks a champion that clashes with your team comp. You...

options.text: Brainstorm new strategies that can make the unusual comp work effectively
Say nothing and adjust your playstyle to complement their pick
Focus on your own role and do your best regardless of their pick
Politely suggest they switch to a more suitable champion for the team comp

questions.text: You’ve just won a teamfight and have low health. You...

options.text: Retreat to a safe brush to heal up solo before re-engaging
Ping your team to follow you and take the nearest objective together
Keep pushing the lane, using minions as a shield while you look for enemy stragglers
Recall to base to heal and buy items before pushing further

questions.text: You’re in a ranked game and your team is falling behind in vision score. You...

options.text: List the exact vision gaps and tell each player where to place wards immediately
Buy a control ward and place it in the enemy jungle’s key brush
Remind your team gently to ward, since vision is crucial for avoiding ganks
Propose a vision rotation where each player takes turns warding different areas

questions.text: A new meta patch drops with big changes to your main champion. You...

options.text: Spend an hour in practice tool alone to adjust to the champion’s new mechanics
Create a structured practice plan to master the updated champion step by step
Join a voice chat with friends to discuss the changes and test new builds together
Pick up a random new champion instead, curious to try something different

questions.text: You’re facing a team that’s constantly grouping up and pushing lanes together. You...

options.text: Analyze the enemy’s push pattern and set up turret dives to take out key members
Focus on farming and scaling, waiting until your team has enough items to fight them
Coordinate with your team to set up ambushes in the river to catch enemies off guard
Initiate split pushes to force the enemy team to split up and defend multiple lanes

results.title: ISTJ - The Steadfast Sentinel
results.description: You’re the reliable backbone of any LoL team. You stick to meta builds, follow game plans to the letter, and never skip warding key areas. You prioritize objective control over flashy plays, and you always show up for your teammates in critical moments. Your steady, methodical approach makes you a rock your team can depend on.

results.title: ISFJ - The Nurturing Guardian
results.description: You’re the supportive teammate who always has your team’s back. You prioritize keeping allies alive over getting kills, share vision with teammates constantly, and calm tensions when arguments break out in chat. Your selfless playstyle and attention to your team’s needs make every game feel safe and collaborative for everyone.

results.title: INFJ - The Strategic Visionary
results.description: You’re the quiet mastermind behind your team’s biggest wins. You predict enemy movements before they happen, design long-term game plans that lead to victory, and guide your team without needing to take the spotlight. Your ability to see the bigger picture turns even the most hopeless games into unexpected comebacks.

results.title: INTJ - The Tactical Architect
results.description: You’re the LoL player who plans three steps ahead. You draft unbeatable team comps, exploit enemy weaknesses with precision, and never let emotions cloud your judgment. You thrive on outsmarting opponents and turning their own plays against them. Your sharp, analytical mind makes you a feared opponent in any ranked match.

results.title: ISTP - The Adaptive Maverick
results.description: You’re the improvisational genius of the rift. You love off-meta builds, pull off clutch outplays with quick reflexes, and thrive in chaotic teamfights. You don’t follow plans—you make them up on the fly, turning unexpected situations into opportunities to shine. Your ability to adapt makes you a wildcard no enemy can predict.

results.title: ISFP - The Artistic Skirmisher
results.description: You’re the creative player who makes the rift feel like a canvas. You pick champions for their aesthetic appeal, pull off flashy plays just for the fun of it, and prioritize enjoying the game over grinding ranks. Your laid-back, expressive playstyle brings joy to every match, even when things don’t go your way.

results.title: INFP - The Idealistic Dreamer
results.description: You’re the LoL player who plays with heart. You champion underdog champions, refuse to flame teammates even when they make mistakes, and believe every game can be a comeback. You play to connect with friends and create positive memories, not just to win. Your kind, optimistic spirit makes you a beloved teammate.

results.title: INTP - The Curious Innovator
results.description: You’re the player who experiments with every possible strategy. You test weird champion interactions, design unorthodox builds, and spend hours in practice tool exploring mechanics. You don’t care about meta—you care about figuring out what works. Your curiosity and creativity lead to game-breaking discoveries no one else sees.

results.title: ESTP - The Bold Daredevil
results.description: You’re the high-energy player who lives for clutch plays. You initiate risky turret dives, make aggressive plays that leave your team gasping, and thrive on the adrenaline of close calls. You don’t overthink—you act on instinct, turning every game into an exciting adventure. Your boldness makes you a thrill to play with.

results.title: ESFP - The Energetic Entertainer
results.description: You’re the life of the party in every LoL match. You crack jokes in chat, celebrate every kill with enthusiastic pings, and turn even the most intense games into a fun experience. You love playing flashy, high-damage champions and showing off your skills to your team. Your upbeat energy lifts everyone’s mood.

results.title: ENFP - The Inspiring Spark
results.description: You’re the teammate who rallies everyone to victory. You come up with wild, creative strategies that catch enemies off guard, encourage your team to take risks, and turn losing streaks around with your infectious positivity. You play to inspire others and create unforgettable game moments. Your passion is contagious.

results.title: ENTP - The Unpredictable Trickster
results.description: You’re the LoL player who thrives on chaos. You pick trollish off-meta champions, pull off unexpected plays that leave enemies confused, and love outsmarting opponents with clever mind games. You don’t follow rules—you make them up, turning every match into a battle of wits. Your unpredictability makes you a nightmare to face.

results.title: ESTJ - The Commanding Leader
results.description: You’re the no-nonsense leader who takes charge of every match. You call shots in teamfights, enforce objective priorities, and make sure everyone stays on task. You value efficiency and results over fun, and you know exactly what it takes to win. Your strong leadership turns disorganized teams into well-oiled winning machines.

results.title: ESFJ - The Collaborative Coordinator
results.description: You’re the teammate who keeps everyone connected. You organize team objectives, check in on struggling allies, and make sure everyone feels heard in chat. You prioritize team harmony over individual glory, and you work tirelessly to make sure everyone has a good time while winning. Your warmth makes you a natural team player.

results.title: ENFJ - The Charismatic Mentor
results.description: You’re the inspiring leader who brings out the best in everyone. You teach new players the ropes, motivate your team to push past their limits, and turn hesitant teammates into confident competitors. You see the potential in every player and help them unlock it. Your charisma and wisdom make you a respected figure in every lobby.

results.title: ENTJ - The Dominant Strategist
results.description: You’re the ruthless leader who crushes every opponent. You draft perfect team comps, execute flawless game plans, and demand excellence from your teammates. You don’t just win—you dominate, leaving enemies with no chance to recover. Your strong will and strategic mind make you one of the most feared players in the rift.
